_comment: The staff package's own bundle. `appName` is what a wallet calls it on a tile — a convention on this bundle rather than a field in the package format, because every other sentence a person reads is already a key here. `notStaff` is the one sentence somebody may read before they have read anything else about this application, so it says what to do rather than what went wrong.
